recentItems.title: Peruvian Bananas Make Historic Debut in China via Chancay-Shanghai Shipping Route
recentItems.description:
Fresh Peruvian bananas made their long-awaited debut in the Chinese market, as the first-ever shipment totaling 19.6 tons arrived via the Chancay-Shanghai shipping route and cleared customs at Yangshan Port on September 2, marking a milestone in bilateral agricultural trade.

recentItems.title: 599,300 Evacuated over Rainstorms in East China Province
recentItems.description:
A total of 599,300 residents have been evacuated from risky offshore and onshore areas in east China's Fujian Province as of the night of September 4 due to persistent torrential rains over the past days, according to the provincial flood control and drought relief headquarters.
